formal: bandwidth_apportion(total, weights) approximates [max(minimum, (w / sum(weights)) * total) for w in weights]

precondition: total >= 0 and minimum >= 0 and weights is valid
formal: bandwidth_apportion(total, weights) == bandwidth_apportion(k * total, k * weights) for any positive k
ValueError is raised if total < 0 or minimum < 0 or weights is empty or sum(weights) == 0
